title: Unreal Engine 4 - GT.TV Exclusive Development Walkthrough
summary: A GameTrailers walkthrough from E3 2012 of an Unreal Engine 4 real-time tech demo with Epic's Alan Willard. It shows live code changes and hot reloading while the game runs.
why: HN cites it as a favorite demo of live coding and hot reload in a game engine.

quote.text: This is my favorite Unreal 4 demo
